L159: 
L160: The QCEW program uses the cite144†North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) as to assign establishments to industries and to report industry data at highly detailed as well as at aggregated levels. Detailed industry NAICS-coded QCEW data are available from 1990 forward, using the following time-version pairings.
L161:   * For the years 1990 to 2006, QCEW data were coded using the cite145†2002 version of NAICS.
L162:   * For periods from 2007 to 2010, QCEW data were coded using the cite146†2007 version of NAICS.
L163:   * For periods from 2011 to 2016, QCEW data were coded using the cite147†2012 version of NAICS.
L164:   * For periods from 2017 to 2021, QCEW data were coded using the cite148†2017 version of NAICS.
L165:   * QCEW data from 2022-forward are and will be coded using the cite149†2022 version of NAICS.
